The '''Bryx sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
The sector was the site of fighting between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the final days of the war, a Republic [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]] was shot down during fighting over the planet [[Du Mai]]. Its pilot survived but suffered head injuries in the crash, becoming a [[Prophet/Legends|prophet]] figure to the people of the planet. It was not until [[21 ABY/Legends|21 ABY]] that this "[[Lost Prophet]]" was identified as a missing [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

The [[Bryx Freedom Fighters]], a [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] force under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horn Ambigene/Legends|Horn Ambigene]], were active in the sector following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as the [[Bryx Sector Force]]. However, this led to the brutal subjugation of the sector by the Empire.<ref name="TEGtW" />
